tools.name: nc_changes

tools.name: nc_forget
tools.description: Deletes the app file the owner uploaded and the plan built from it. Use it when the owner asks to delete their uploaded file. what=all also clears the queued changes. Safe to repeat. It does not touch tokens or billing.

tools.description: The basket for finishing the move. list shows every add-on with its price and how it is previewed, and which add-ons and queued changes are switched on. switch turns one on or off (an add-on id such as dark_mode, or a change_id such as chg_01). tools.name: nc_schema
tools.description: Generates numbered D1 migration SQL files and a Drizzle schema from the agreed plan (nc_plan), and writes them to the customer's R2 under nc/<job>/schema/. With apply: true it creates the D1 database in the customer's account and runs the migrations. Safe to repeat: every statement is idempotent. Ru

tools.name: nc_export
tools.description: Pages through the source app's records (read only) into NDJSON objects in the customer's R2 bucket. Resumable: progress is saved after every page, so a stopped run continues where it stopped. Each call does a bounded slice and returns status partial until every type is done; call it again. Pass sinc

tools.name: nc_load
tools.description: Loads the staged records into the customer's D1 database by upsert on id. A second run changes zero rows. tools.description: Checks the loaded data and says pass or fail: row counts per type against the source's count now, a checksum sample (default 500 records per type, sha256 of the canonical JSON of the mapped columns, read back from D1), broken foreign keys, and that every copied file exists in R2. Writes verification

tools.name: nc_cutover
tools.description: Refuses to run unless the last nc_verify passed and nothing was exported, loaded, copied or imported after it. tools.description: Free 10-page interactive preview (core routes first); full site and add-ons unlock at checkout. Free

tools.name: nc_preview_status
tools.description: Shows how the free preview is going: each page's state, its automatic score (visible text, working buttons, data fields, phone width), what it cost, and when the preview is deleted. Read only.

tools.name: nc_move
tools.description: Moves a Bubble® app to the owner's own Cloudflare account in order: app file, free preview, price and payment, Cloudflare token (Bubble Data API key optional, only if you want existing records moved; structure, pages, and option sets move without it and it is addable later), deploy and go-live. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nc_changes, nc_basket, nc_files, nc_users · Private data: nc_ping, nc_audit, nc_connect, nc_compile_plan, nc_forget, nc_basket, nc_schema, nc_export, nc_load, nc_files, nc_users, nc_access, nc_verify, nc_redirects, nc_cutover, nc_account, nc_preview, nc_move · Public sink: nc_connect, nc_changes, nc_basket, nc_finalise_quote, nc_users, nc_cutover, nc_move · Destructive: nc_changes, nc_forget, nc_schema, nc_export, nc_load, nc_verify, nc_redirects, nc_cutover.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nc_changes, nc_basket, nc_files, nc_users · Private data: nc_ping, nc_audit, nc_connect, nc_compile_plan, nc_forget, nc_basket, nc_schema, nc_export, nc_load, nc_files, nc_users, nc_access, nc_verify, nc_redirects, nc_cutover, nc_account, nc_preview, nc_move · Public sink: nc_connect, nc_changes, nc_basket, nc_finalise_quote, nc_users, nc_cutover, nc_move · Destructive: nc_changes, nc_forget, nc_schema, nc_export, nc_load, nc_verify, nc_redirects, nc_cutover

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
